निज् निज्, cl. 3. P. A. नेनेक्ति (3rd pl.
नेनिजति), नेनिक्ते, निनेज, निनिजे,
नेक्ता, नेक्ष्यति, -ते, अनिजत्, अनैक्षीत्, अनिक्त,
नेक्तुम्, to wash, clean, cleanse, purify; A. to wash
or clean one's self; to nourish: Pass. निज्यते, &c.,
to be washed: Caus. नेजयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अनीनि-
जत्: Desid. निनिक्षति, -ते: Intens. नेनिज्यते,
नेनिजीति, नेनेक्ति; [cf. rt. निञ्ज्: Zend śnizh, ‘to
snow:’ Gr. νίζ-ω, νίπ-τ-ω, χέρ-νιβ-α (acc.) νίπ-
τρο-ν, νῐ́φ-α (acc.), νιφ-ά(δ)-ς, νῐφ-ετό-ς, νῑ́φει:
Lat. Nep-tūnu-s = νιπτόμενο-ς, ‘bathing;’ ning-
i-t, ningu-i-t, ningu-i-s, nix, base niv for nigv:
Goth. snaivs, ‘snow:’ Old Germ. sneo, ‘snow;’
sniwit, ‘it snows:’ Lith. snig-ti, sning-ti, ‘to
snow;’ snḗg-a-s, ‘snow;’ snaig-alà, ‘a flake of
snow:’ Slav. sne†g-ŭ, ‘snow:’ Hib. nigh-im, ‘I
wash;’ nigh-te, ‘washed,’ = Sanskrit निक्त.]

निज नि-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. rt. जन् with नि),
innate, native, congenital, indigenous; own, of one's
own party or country; proper, peculiar; continual, per-
petual; (आस्), m. pl. one's own people. नि-ज is used
in later Sanskrit as a reflexive possessive pronoun, like
स्व, for ‘my own,’ ‘his own,’ ‘our own,’ &c.; and
frequently for simple ‘my,’ ‘his,’ ‘our,’ &c.
—निज-
कर्मन्, अ, n. one's own work, any duty pertaining
to one's self.
—निज-कर्म-बन्धन, अस्, आ,
अम्, fettered by one's own works.
—निज-घास,
अस्, m. ‘devouring his own,’ N. of a demon.
—निज-
धृति, इस्, f., N. of a river in Śāka-dvīpa.
—निज-
मुक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, (according to the commentators)
= स्वभाव-मुक्त, liberated in own nature, essen-
tially liberated (?).
—निज-लाभ-पूर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्,
engrossed in self-interest, self-satisfied.
—निज-स्व,
अम्, n. own property.
—निजार्थम् (˚ज-अर्˚), ind.
for one's own sake, for one's self.

निजघ्नि नि-जघ्नि, इस्, इस्, इ (fr. नि-हन्), Ved.
striking down, overpowering; [cf. जघ्नि.]

निजानुका नि-जानुका, f. (fr. नि-जानु), Ved.
shaking or trembling of the knees (?).

निजिघृक्षयत् नि-जिघृक्षयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्
(Caus. of Desid. of rt. ग्रह् with नि), causing to be
desirous of overpowering or excelling.

निजुर्व् नि-जुर्व् or नि-जूर्व्, cl. 1. P. -जूर्वति,
&c., to consume by fire; (Sāy.) to destroy, kill.
नि-जुर्, ऊर्, f., Ved. killing, destroying.

निजुह्नूषु नि-जुह्नूषु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. Desid.
of rt. ह्नु with नि), wishing to conceal or deny.
